The 9th Private Equity San Francisco Forum serves as the West Coast hub for growth equity and venture capital networking, scheduled on November 16-17, 2026. Targeting the Silicon Valley ecosystem, this forum provides a curated platform for hundreds of institutional investors and GPs to discuss tech-sector valuations, secondary market liquidity, and late-stage financing trends in the current interest rate environment.Qualified LPs and investment and operational GPs receive complimentary registration.

Join us at the Private Equity San Francisco Event for an exclusive opportunity to engage with industry leaders and experts. Hear from General Partners, including Managing Directors, Operating Partners, Chief Financial Officers, and Investment Directors, as well as Chief Investment Officers and investment committee members representing institutional investors and ultra-high-net-worth wealth management clients.

Hear from Chief Investment Officers & Heads of Private Equity from the top LPs on the west coast as they discuss best practices for manager selection and due diligence.

Panels will dive into capitalizing on high-growth tech sectors like AI and fintech, exploring effective fundraising strategies in a challenging market, and the CFO’s role in enhancing track record performance.

Network with peers and gain actionable insights to navigate the evolving private equity landscape.Register Now!

Mr. Lawson is Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder of HGGC. Mr. Lawson has been involved in all phases of the firm’s development since its formation and directs the firm’s strategy and investment decisions, governance and investor relations. Since HGGC’s inception, Mr. Lawson has overseen over 700 completed transactions representing more than $80 billion in aggregate transaction value. Mr. Lawson also serves as a director, chairman emeritus or trustee on several philanthropic and cultural institutions including the Capital Impact Foundation, San Francisco Zoo, Wasatch Adaptive Sports and the Forever Young Foundation. Mr. Lawson received his M.B.A. from Harvard Business School and B.A. from Amherst College.

Rishi Kapoor is Investcorp’s Vice Chairman and Chief Investment Officer (CIO). He has been with the firm for over 30 years, having served as Investcorp’s Co-Chief Executive Officer from 2015 to 2024, and as Chief Financial Officer from 2003 to 2015. Rishi joined Investcorp in 1992 from Citigroup. He holds a bachelor’s degree in electrical and computer engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), and an MBA from Duke University’s Fuqua School of Business. Rishi is a member of Duke University’s Middle East Regional Advisory Board, the Oxford Energy Policy Club, and His Majesty King Charles’ Sustainable Markets Initiative. Additionally, he sits on the Board of Directors for the National Bank of Bahrain, where he chairs the Risk & Compliance Committee. Rishi is a frequent speaker at industry events and conferences and has been recognized by Forbes Middle East as one of the top 10 Indian executives in the region. Top CEO Middle East also named him one of the top CEOs in the GCC in 2018.

Yann Robard is Managing Partner of Dawson. Established in 2015, Dawson (formerly Whitehorse Liquidity Partners) is a leading global alternative asset manager focused on providing innovative structured solutions to the private markets. Dawson has US$20 billion of assets under management and over 200 employees. Since inception, the Firm has deployed over US$25 billion across more than 240 transactions. Prior to Dawson, Yann spent a cumulative 13 years at CPP Investment Board (“CPPIB”). Yann joined CPPIB in 2001 at the inception of its private equity investment program. He was Managing Director, Head of Secondaries and Co-Investments in 2015 when he left CPPIB to establish Dawson. Yann holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Dalhousie University and is a Chartered Financial Analyst (“CFA”) Charterholder.

Adam Vigna is co-founder & Chief Investment Officer of Sagard since 2016. As the firm’s CIO, Adam is actively involved in all investment decisions made across the platform and is responsible for Sagard’s overall investment activities, including investment strategy, governance, and portfolio construction. Adam also serves as Chief Investment Officer of Sagard Credit Partners. Adam is a member of the Management Committee and is currently a director of Peak Achievement Athletics. He is based in Toronto, Canada. Prior to Sagard, Adam spent nearly a decade at the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (“CPPIB”) where he was Managing Director and Global Head of CPPIB’s Principal Credit Investments Group (“PCI”) with approximately CA$20B of AUM. While at CPPIB, Adam was one of the founding members of CPPIB’s Principal Credit Investment Group and led CPPIB’s acquisition of Antares Capital in 2015. Adam holds a B.Comm. (Honours) degree from Queen’s University in Kingston, Ontario.

Over 25 years, L.T. has established a career as a distinctive operator, serial entrepreneur and forward-looking investor. As an operator, L.T. has served in executive-level roles at leading, global institutions Airbnb (CFO, Head of Payments, Customer Experience & Corporate Development), Blackstone (CFO, Management and Risk Committee Member, Head of the Innovations Fund and Blackstone Treasury Solutions Fund), and Merrill Lynch (COO, CFO, Risk Committee, Head of Corp. Dev. and eCommerce). As an entrepreneur, L.T. was a founding partner or early investor behind several tech-enabled, disruptive businesses across e-commerce, private markets technology and cyber-security. As a founder and investor, L.T. created industry changing platforms Ipreo, TMC Bonds, TheMarkets.com, iLevel and CNBC.com, and was an early investor in Addepar, Airbnb, FLYR, GoodLeap, Hopper, iCapital, Point, and StubHub. L.T. is the Managing Partner and Founder of WestCap, an operating equity investor in technology companies that he originally formed in 1997 as Weston Capital Partners, and now has $6B in assets under management and 38 portfolio companies. L.T. earned a B.A., MBA, and J.D. degrees from Georgetown University, where he serves on the Board of Directors and on the Endowment Committee, and has been a consistent supporter of scholarships through his family foundation.

Raymond Svider is a Partner, Chairman of BC Partners and Chairman of its Executive Committee. He joined BC Partners in Paris in 1992 before moving to the London office in 2000 and relocated to New York in 2008. Previously, Mr. Svider worked in investment banking at Wasserstein Perella in New York and Paris, and at the Boston Consulting Group in Chicago. Mr. Svider has an MBA from the University of Chicago, an MSc in engineering from Ecole Polytechnique and a degree in Electrical Engineering from Ecole Nationale Superieure des Telecommunications. Mr. Svider is currently Executive Chairman of PetSmart, Chairman of the Board of Chewy, Inc. (NYSE “CHWY”) and Chairman of the Board of Madison Logic. He also serves on the boards of Valtech, Altice USA (NYSE “ATUS”), and EAB. Mr. Svider additionally serves on the Board of the Polsky Center Private Equity Council at the University of Chicago; he is a Council Member on the Council of Chicago Booth and is on the Board of Trustees of the NightingaleBambord school.

As Partner, Global Head of Carlyle AlpInvest, Ruulke Bagijn is part of the leader-ship team of one of largest global investment firms in the world. She also serves as Chair of the Board of Carlyle AlpInvest, Carlyle’s dedicated private equity primary fund, co-investment, and secondary solutions platform with $80 billion AUM (per Q1 2024) and investment professionals in New York, San Francisco, London, Am-sterdam, Hong Kong, and Singapore. In addition, Ms. Bagijn is a member of the Carlyle AlpInvest Global Investment Committee, which makes all investment deci-sions in Europe, North and Latin America, Asia, and Australia on behalf of its 450+ investors worldwide. Based in New York, Ms. Bagijn has 20+ years of experience in global investments and a deep knowledge of private capital portfolios. She joined Carlyle AlpInvest from AXA Investment Managers – Real Assets, where she was the Global Head of Real Assets Private Equity and a member of its Manage-ment Board. Before that, she was Co-Chief Investment Officer of Investment Man-agement and Chief Investment Officer of Private Markets at PGGM, with direct re-sponsibility for managing investments in infrastructure, hedge funds, structured credit, private equity, insurance-linked securities, and private real estate, and held senior roles at ABN AMRO. A passionate advocate of the business case for diver-sity, including more women in private equity, Ms. Bagijn has been named a Wall Street Journal Pro PE ‘Woman to Watch.’ Born in the Netherlands, she was also the inaugural chair of the Dutch committee of Level 20, the not-for-profit body es-tablished to inspire women to join and succeed in the Private Equity industry in the Netherlands. Ms. Bagijn received an MSc in economics from Erasmus University Rotterdam, is a CFA charterholder, and serves as a Board member of the Nether-land-America Foundation (NAF), which supports high-impact exchange between the two countries.

Alex is Alpine’s General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer and oversees Legal & Compliance, ESG and D&I, IT & security, HR, and firm administration.Prior to joining Alpine, Alex was Head of Compliance and Senior Counsel for Private Equity at Vista Equity Partners. Prior to Vista, Alex was in the government enforcement practice group of Ropes & Gray and an Assistant Attorney General in the New York State Office of the Attorney General. Alex holds a BS from Boston University and a JD from The George Washington University Law School.

Ayanna Clunis is a Partner and Head of Operations at TPG based in Fort Worth, Texas. Prior to joining TPG, Ayanna was with J.P. Morgan where she most recently served as a Managing Director and Head of Markets Operations Transformation and Securities Operations within the Corporate and Investment Banking Division. She brings more than 20 years of experience in financial services, including at Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and Citi, where she led complex organizational change and implemented innovative technical solutions to enable efficiency and scale. Ayanna earned her MBA from Fuqua School of Business at Duke University, and a BS in Chemical Engineering from Cornell University. She currently serves on the Board of First Candle and Duke University Alumni Council and is Board Chair of Measures for Justice.

Bertrand Villon is a Managing Director in the International Private Equity team at La Caisse. Based in New York, he leads the firm’s direct investment activities in the business services and industrials sectors across North America, since 2015. He has successfully executed several notable transactions for La Caisse, including investments in Allied Universal, Clarios, ICR, Grant Thornton Advisors LLC, and Pike Corporation. Prior to joining La Caisse, Mr. Villon worked with Investcorp, where he was responsible for sourcing, executing, and managing private equity investments across a range of industries in North America and Europe. He began his career in M&A advisory at Rothschild. Mr. Villon holds an MBA from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania and an MSc in Management from HEC Paris. He currently serves on the Board of Directors of Allied Universal, Clarios, ICR, and Pike Corporation.

Calvin Chock is Head of Digital Transformation at Vistria Group. Prior to joining Vistria, Calvin was the Chief Product Officer at Clover Health, a technology focused healthcare company offering Medicare Advantage and value based care services. He previously led Engineering and Product Management at McKesson’s Specialty division, led Enterprise Reporting and

p: 이 사이트는 reCAPTCHA의 보호를 받으며, Google 개인정보처리방침 및 서비스 약관이 적용됩니다.

제9회 사모펀드 샌프란시스코 포럼은 2026년 11월 16일부터 17일까지 개최되며, 성장형 투자 및 벤처 캐피탈 네트워킹을 위한 서부 해안의 허브 역할을 합니다. 실리콘밸리 생태계를 대상으로 하는 이 포럼은 수백 명의 기관 투자자와 GP들이 현재 금리 환경에서 기술 부문 가치 평가, 세컨더리 시장 유동성, 후기 단계 자금 조달 동향을 논의할 수 있는 선별된 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 자격을 갖춘 LP 및 투자 및 운영 GP는 무료로 등록할 수 있습니다.
사모펀드 샌프란시스코 행사에 참여하여 업계 리더 및 전문가들과 교류할 수 있는 특별한 기회를 잡으십시오. 매니징 디렉터, 운영 파트너, 최고재무책임자, 투자 디렉터를 포함한 GP뿐만 아니라 기관 투자자 및 초고액 자산 관리 고객을 대표하는 최고투자책임자 및 투자 위원회 위원들의 이야기를 들어보십시오.
서부 해안의 최고 LP들의 최고투자책임자 및 사모펀드 책임자들로부터 매니저 선정 및 실사 모범 사례에 대한 이야기를 들어보십시오.
패널들은 AI 및 핀테크와 같은 고성장 기술 부문에서 자본을 활용하는 방법, 어려운 시장에서 효과적인 펀드레이징 전략을 모색하는 방법, 그리고 실적 성과를 향상시키는 데 있어 CFO의 역할에 대해 심층적으로 논의할 것입니다.
동료들과 네트워킹하고 진화하는 사모펀드 환경을 탐색하는 데 도움이 되는 실행 가능한 통찰력을 얻으십시오. 지금 등록하십시오!

Lawson 씨는 HGGC의 최고경영자이자 공동 설립자입니다. Lawson 씨는 회사 설립 이후 모든 개발 단계에 참여했으며, 회사의 전략 및 투자 결정, 거버넌스 및 투자자 관계를 총괄하고 있습니다. HGGC 설립 이후 Lawson 씨는 총 800억 달러 이상의 거래 가치를 나타내는 700건 이상의 거래를 감독했습니다. Lawson 씨는 또한 Capital Impact Foundation, San Francisco Zoo, Wasatch Adaptive Sports 및 Forever Young Foundation을 포함한 여러 자선 및 문화 기관의 이사, 명예 회장 또는 이사로 활동하고 있습니다. Lawson 씨는 하버드 비즈니스 스쿨에서 MBA를, Amherst College에서 학사 학위를 받았습니다.

Rishi Kapoor는 Investcorp의 부회장이자 최고투자책임자(CIO)입니다. 그는 30년 이상 회사에 재직했으며, 2015년부터 2024년까지 Investcorp의 공동 최고경영자, 2003년부터 2015년까지 최고재무책임자를 역임했습니다. Rishi는 1992년 Citigroup에서 Investcorp에 합류했습니다. 그는 인도 공과대학교(IIT)에서 전기 및 컴퓨터 공학 학사 학위를, 듀크 대학교 푸쿠아 경영대학원에서 MBA를 취득했습니다. Rishi는 듀크 대학교 중동 지역 자문 위원회, 옥스퍼드 에너지 정책 클럽, 찰스 3세 국왕의 지속 가능한 시장 이니셔티브의 회원입니다. 또한 그는 National Bank of Bahrain의 이사회에 참여하여 위험 및 규정 준수 위원회 의장을 맡고 있습니다. Rishi는 업계 행사 및 컨퍼런스에서 자주 연사로 활동하며, Forbes Middle East에 의해 이 지역의 상위 10대 인도계 경영진 중 한 명으로 선정되었습니다. Top CEO Middle East 또한 2018년에 그를 GCC 지역의 최고 CEO 중 한 명으로 선정했습니다.

Yann Robard는 Dawson의 매니징 파트너입니다. 2015년에 설립된 Dawson(이전 Whitehorse Liquidity Partners)은 사모 시장에 혁신적인 구조화 솔루션을 제공하는 선도적인 글로벌 대체 자산 운용사입니다. Dawson은 200억 달러의 운용 자산과 200명 이상의 직원을 보유하고 있습니다. 설립 이후 회사는 240건 이상의 거래에 걸쳐 250억 달러 이상을 투자했습니다. Dawson에 합류하기 전 Yann은 CPP Investment Board(“CPPIB”)에서 총 13년을 보냈습니다. Yann은 2001년 CPPIB의 사모펀드 투자 프로그램 시작과 함께 합류했습니다. 그는 2015년 Dawson을 설립하기 위해 CPPIB를 떠날 당시 세컨더리 및 공동 투자 부문 매니징 디렉터 겸 책임자였습니다. Yann은 달하우지 대학교에서 상업 학사 학위를 취득했으며 공인재무분석사(“CFA”) 자격증을 보유하고 있습니다.

Adam Vigna는 2016년부터 Sagard의 공동 설립자이자 최고투자책임자입니다. 회사의 CIO로서 Adam은 플랫폼 전반에 걸쳐 이루어지는 모든 투자 결정에 적극적으로 참여하며, 투자 전략, 거버넌스 및 포트폴리오 구성을 포함한 Sagard의 전반적인 투자 활동을 책임지고 있습니다. Adam은 또한 Sagard Credit Partners의 최고투자책임자도 맡고 있습니다. Adam은 경영 위원회 위원이며 현재 Peak Achievement Athletics의 이사입니다. 그는 캐나다 토론토에 거주하고 있습니다. Sagard에 합류하기 전 Adam은 캐나다 연금 투자 위원회(“CPPIB”)에서 거의 10년 동안 근무했으며, 약 200억 캐나다 달러의 운용 자산을 보유한 CPPIB의 Principal Credit Investments Group(“PCI”)의 매니징 디렉터 겸 글로벌 책임자였습니다. CPPIB 재직 중 Adam은 CPPIB의 Principal Credit Investment Group의 창립 멤버 중 한 명이었으며 2015년 CPPIB의 Antares Capital 인수를 주도했습니다. Adam은 온타리오주 킹스턴에 있는 퀸즈 대학교에서 상업 학사(우등) 학위를 취득했습니다.

25년이 넘는 기간 동안 L.T.는 독특한 운영자, 연쇄 창업가, 미래 지향적인 투자자로서 경력을 쌓았습니다. 운영자로서 L.T.는 선도적인 글로벌 기관인 Airbnb(CFO, 결제, 고객 경험 및 기업 개발 책임자), Blackstone(CFO, 경영 및 위험 위원회 위원, 혁신 펀드 및 Blackstone Treasury Solutions Fund 책임자), Merrill Lynch(COO, CFO, 위험 위원회, 기업 개발 및 전자상거래 책임자)에서 임원급 역할을 수행했습니다. 기업가로서 L.T.는 전자상거래, 사모 시장 기술 및 사이버 보안 분야에서 여러 기술 기반의 파괴적인 비즈니스의 창립 파트너 또는 초기 투자자였습니다. 창립자이자 투자자로서 L.T.는 Ipreo, TMC Bonds, TheMarkets.com, iLevel 및 CNBC.com과 같은 산업 변화 플랫폼을 만들었으며, Addepar, Airbnb, FLYR, GoodLeap, Hopper, iCapital, Point 및 StubHub의 초기 투자자였습니다. L.T.는 WestCap의 매니징 파트너이자 설립자이며, WestCap은 그가 1997년에 Weston Capital Partners로 처음 설립한 기술 기업에 대한 운영 지분 투자자이며, 현재 60억 달러의 운용 자산과 38개의 포트폴리오 회사를 보유하고 있습니다. L.T.는 조지타운 대학교에서 학사, MBA 및 J.D. 학위를 취득했으며, 현재 이사회 및 기금 위원회에서 활동하고 있으며, 가족 재단을 통해 장학금을 꾸준히 지원해 왔습니다.

Raymond Svider는 BC Partners의 파트너이자 회장이며, 집행 위원회 회장입니다. 그는 1992년 파리에서 BC Partners에 합류한 후 2000년 런던 사무실로 옮겼고 2008년 뉴욕으로 이전했습니다. 이전에는 뉴욕과 파리의 Wasserstein Perella에서 투자 은행 업무를, 시카고의 Boston Consulting Group에서 근무했습니다. Svider 씨는 시카고 대학교에서 MBA를, 에콜 폴리테크니크에서 공학 석사 학위를, 에콜 나시오날 쉬페리외르 데 텔레콤에서 전기 공학 학위를 취득했습니다. Svider 씨는 현재 PetSmart의 집행 위원회 회장, Chewy, Inc.(NYSE “CHWY”) 이사회 회장, Madison Logic 이사회 회장입니다. 그는 또한 Valtech, Altice USA(NYSE “ATUS”) 및 EAB의 이사회에도 참여하고 있습니다. Svider 씨는 또한 시카고 대학교 Polsky Center Private Equity Council 이사회 위원으로 활동하고 있으며, 시카고 부스 위원회 위원이며 NightingaleBambord 학교의 이사회 이사입니다.
